subject: New State Safe Passing Law and Infrastructure Updates
overview: The commission discussed the implementation of the state Act to Reduce Traffic Fatalities, specifically the new four-foot passing requirement and local speed limit authority. Members also reviewed infrastructure updates for Winthrop Street and Bluebikes expansion, and initiated a prioritized pothole reporting strategy for the DPW.

items.title: Announcements
items.summary: The Chair reported sending a letter of support for a Mystic River Watershed Association grant application to fund a bike connection feasibility study.

items.title: Act to Reduce Traffic Fatalities
items.summary: The commission discussed the implications of the new state law, focusing on the four-foot safe passing distance, municipal authority over state road speed limits, and updated lighting requirements. Members proposed creating educational stickers and social media campaigns to publicize these changes to the public.

items.title: Strategy for Infrastructure Advocacy
items.summary: Members discussed ways to mobilize vocal public support for safety projects to counter perceived opposition and provide political coverage for city engineers. Suggestions included using SeeClickFix more effectively and establishing a newsletter to alert residents to public meetings regarding upcoming road redesigns.

items.title: Infrastructure and Bluebikes Updates
items.summary: The Transportation Engineer explained that cold weather has delayed permanent pavement markings on Winthrop Street, though temporary lines are in place. The city is also preparing to add seven new Bluebikes stations this season to close gaps between Wellington Station and Medford Square.

items.title: Bike to School Day Planning
items.summary: Early planning began for a spring event at Medford High School to celebrate new bike lanes on Winthrop Street, likely featuring guided caravan rides for students.

items.title: Pothole Triage and Prioritization
items.summary: The commission reviewed a proposed list of high-priority pothole locations and safety criteria to assist the DPW with repair triage. A formal motion to approve the list was withdrawn to allow the Transportation Engineer to first consult with DPW staff regarding their existing prioritization process.

items.title: Bike Lights and Helmet Distribution
items.summary: Approved the purchase of 240 bike light kits for spring distribution and discussed collaborating with the police department to provide free helmets at central locations. Ernie Meunier shared updates on personal liability issues following a crash where police reports contained factual errors.
